claims.statement: Tom Allen and Jem Mace arrived in St. Louis from an extended sparring tour through the Northeast.
claims.excerpt: arrived in &t. Louis yesterday morning from an extended sparring tour throughout the Northeast

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Jem Mace planned to give a couple of sparring exhibitions during their stay in St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: will give a couple - sparring exhibitions during their stay in the city.

notes: Arrival date worked out from 'yesterday morning' in a paper dated 1876-10-24.
